request.description: List all agent definitions, optionally filtered by graph_schema.

List all agents available for composition as sub-agents.Request body (all optional):{    "schema": "SUPERVISOR" | "PIPELINE" (optional, filter eligible agents),    "exclude_ids": [UUID, ...] (optional, exclude certain agents)}Returns:[    {        "id": str,        "name": str,        "graph_schema": str,        "status": "active" | "inactive",        "depth": int    }]

Get hierarchical composition structure for UI preview.Returns:{    "id": str,    "name": str,    "graph_schema": str,    "status": "active" | "inactive",    "depth": int,    "sub_agents": [        {same structure recursively}    ]}

request.description: Return every sync schedule across all datasources.
Create a sync schedule by setting cron on the Airbyte connection.
Get the sync schedule for a datasource.
Update an existing sync schedule.
Remove the sync schedule (set Airbyte connection to manual).
Get combined sync + schedule status for real-time UI updates.

Receive a batch of records from destination-embedding, embed immediately.Called by the custom Airbyte destination connector during sync.Each call processes one batch:  records → Documents → chunks → embed → vector DBOn ``batch_index == 0`` (first batch), existing embeddings are clearedso the full-refresh semantic is preserved.On ``is_last_batch == True``, sync status is marked completed andoptional Graph RAG rebuild is triggered.
Fetch sample records from the original Airbyte source.Used by the frontend documents tab to show raw source datawithout storing it locally.  Queries via Airbyte read API.
Get list of available MCP tools from the specified MCP server.Used by the UI to populate tool selection for pipeline stages.
Get list of available Ollama models.Fetches from Ollama API at OLLAMA_BASE_URL.
Proxy endpoint to get RAG collections from langconnect-api.
Get list of available MCP tools from the built-in tools-service.Uses TOOLS_SERVICE_URL from settings (default: http://localhost:8003/mcp).
Execute a tool on the MCP server and return the result.Uses TOOLS_SERVICE_URL from settings if no URL is provided.
Stream runs for a thread using SDK-compatible format.
Cancel an active run.
Get thread history specific checkpointer states.
List all available Airbyte source connectors.
Get the raw JSON Schema configuration specification for a connector.Returns the native connectionSpecification — NO flattening.The frontend renders it via the recursive SchemaForm.
Validate a connector configuration by testing the connection.Config is the native nested JSON structure from the SchemaForm.
Get available streams for a configured connector.
List all configured data sources.
Create a new data source.1. Create Airbyte source + connection + destination2. Store config in PG collection3. Store Airbyte IDs in mapping table
Get detailed information about a data source with paginated documents.
Update a data source's name, configuration, streams, and/or sync mode.Updates the Airbyte source config, connection streams/sync mode, and local metadata.
Delete a data source, its embeddings, and Airbyte objects.
Trigger synchronization for a data source.If the datasource has an Airbyte connection, triggers via Airbyte API.Falls back to sync queue for manual extraction.
Get current sync status for real-time progress tracking.
Return recent sync job history for a data source from Airbyte.
Get schemas for an assistant's configuration.Returns graph-specific config schemas with x_oap_ui_config metadatafor Open Agent Platform.

Serve a previously uploaded or agent-generated file.Checks in-memory cache first; falls back to MinIO if the servicerestarted since the file was uploaded.XLSX/XLS files are converted to CSV text so that the frontend's CsvContentcomponent can render them as a table without any extra parsing logic —unless ``?download=1`` is set, in which case the original bytes andfilename are served with ``Content-Disposition: attachment`` so thebrowser downloads the real .xlsx file instead.
